name: GitHub Copilot
bestFor: Teams already on GitHub who want the cheapest serious assistant inside VS Code or JetBrains
skipIf: You want an AI-native editor as the whole product
keyFeatures: Plugins for VS Code, JetBrains, and Xcode
Lower entry seat cost than standalone AI IDEs
limitations: Weaker as an autonomous multi-file agent than Cursor or Claude Code
Credit metering applies on premium models
summary: The low-friction plugin. Half the price of Cursor Pro for many individuals. Weaker as a standalone agentic IDE.
body: Copilot’s win is procurement and habit. It lives in the editor you already open, talks to the repo you already host on GitHub, and costs less than the AI-native IDEs at the individual Pro tier. In 2026 it also routes across models and meters some usage as credits, so the sticker $10 is not always the invoice. For enterprises, Copilot is the default because IT already bought GitHub. For a solo Next.js shop, Cursor still feels like the more complete product. Pricing page reviewed 19 Sep 2026.
notes: Watch the credits policy, not only the seat fee
Pair with Claude Code rather than pretending Copilot is a terminal agent
